_doc: Owner 2026-11-22: 'all kinds of triggers' with structure exits. Example: RELIANCE 15m 13 Oct 2026 14:00 EMA13 crosses above EMA20, stop below the last swing low (13 Oct 11:45), target EMA 200. Each trigger = DSL event (liquidity floor added automatically). Each exit = stop + target; 'ema200' = EMA 200 value at the signal candle (trade skipped when price is already above it), 'swing_low' = last confirmed swing low before the signal minus buffer (same rule as the engine), 'rrN' = N x risk, 'pctN' = N%. Trades are held until stop or target (overnight on intraday), one position at a time per trigger x exit.

swing_major._doc: bigger swing: low is the lowest of `strength` candles on each side, searched further back (owner examples: 13 Oct 11:45, 1 Oct 14:00)

triggers.EMA_stack_turns_bull: ema(close, 9) > ema(close, 13) and ema(close, 13) > ema(close, 20) and ema(close, 20) > ema(close, 50) and not (ema(close, 9)[1] > ema(close, 13)[1] and ema(close, 13)[1] > ema(close, 20)[1] and ema(close, 20)[1] > ema(close, 50)[1])
